page.title: About
page.body_html:
Wagvive started with a simple observation: most pet products are designed for the sale, not for the pet.

We build for comfort, health, and grooming — the parts of pet care that quietly make the biggest difference, especially as pets get older. Less tugging during brushing. Better sleep. Water they'll actually want to drink. Small upgrades that add up to a better quality of life.

We're especially mindful of senior pets and the pet parents caring for them, because comfort matters more, not less, as they age.

Every product we carry is chosen with one question in mind: does this genuinely make life better for the pet, not just more convenient for the person buying it.

That's Wagvive. Wellness for every wag.
